proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P G X Y a b hX hY
  have h1 := MeasureTheory.condExp_add (hX.const_mul a) (hY.const_mul b) G
  have h2 := MeasureTheory.condExp_smul (μ := P) a X G
  have h3 := MeasureTheory.condExp_smul (μ := P) b Y G
  have e1 : (fun ω => a * X ω) = a • X := rfl
  have e2 : (fun ω => b * Y ω) = b • Y := rfl
  rw [e1, e2] at h1
  filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3] with ω w1 w2 w3
  have : (fun ω => a * X ω + b * Y ω) = a • X + b • Y := rfl
  rw [this, w1, Pi.add_apply, w2, w3]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (G : MeasurableSpace Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable X P → MeasureTheory.Integrable Y P → (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (fun ω => a * X ω + b * Y ω)) =ᵐ[P] fun ω => a * (MeasureTheory.condExp G P X) ω + b * (MeasureTheory.condExp G P Y) ω
